none: PAS FindID 1002057: Roman copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN VALEN-S P F AVG ; R/ [SECVRI]TAS [REI PVBLICAE]

A worn but complete Roman copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian, dating to the period AD 364-378 (Reece period 19). SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE reverse type depicting Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Unclear mint. Obverse description: Diademed, draped, and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: DN VALEN-S P F AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECVRI]TAS [REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 18.77 mm; Thickness: 1.69 mm; Weight: 2.44g
